# Claritia

> Claritia is the CRM and inbound stack for small B2B teams. It catches every lead on your site, finds out who they are, sends them to the right rep and books the meeting before they leave. Forms, enrichment, routing, scheduling and AI email in one place, live in 15 minutes.

## How it works

- Inbound: forms that book the meeting. Build a form by chatting with AI or keep the ones you have (HubSpot, Webflow, Marketo, Framer, Typeform, plain HTML). The right rep's calendar opens the moment the form is sent, and Claritia names the companies on your site.
- Scheduling: Google or Outlook in one click. Every meeting type (one rep, round robin, the whole team, owner first, group events, polls), booking links, paid meetings with Stripe, reminders and no-show tracking.
- Routing: owners, territories and round robin with caps and time off. Every decision keeps the sentence that made it, and speed-to-lead nudges a rep who is slow.
- Automation: enrichment (your records first, then vendors), AI qualify that only picks an outcome you set, workflows on one canvas, and two-way CRM sync.
- Nurture: emails written from your own content and sent from your own domain, approved before they send; segments and lead scoring.
- CRM: contacts, companies, opportunities and meetings in one place, import from 20 tools, a board view, and reports inside each section.
- Sending runs on Resend.

## The suite

- Found by Arrowsterr (SEO and AI search). Converted by Claritia. Closed with Omniscient.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tryclaritia.com/): what Claritia does
- [Forms](https://tryclaritia.com/products/forms): forms built from a sentence, with steps, logic, prices, payments and booking inside
- [Meetings](https://tryclaritia.com/products/meetings): booking pages, team meetings, polls and reminders on Google and Outlook
- [Routing](https://tryclaritia.com/products/routing): each lead to the right meeting and person, with round robin and a log of every decision
- [Pricing](https://tryclaritia.com/pricing): Free, Starter $15, Pro $39 and Business $79 a month with 1 host, then a price per extra host ([Markdown](https://tryclaritia.com/pricing.md))
- [Form templates](https://tryclaritia.com/templates): 150 free forms for 24 industries (demo requests, quotes, intake, applications, surveys, quizzes), each with its own page to try it and use it
- [App](https://app.tryclaritia.com): sign in and start
